changeSet.author: ticketwave
changeSet.comment: Bookings: an optional caller-supplied idempotency key, so a client retrying POST /api/bookings after a timeout doesn't create a duplicate booking (and double-hold seats). Nullable, since it's opt-in per caller rather than required on every booking creation; PostgreSQL's UNIQUE constraint allows any number of NULLs, so callers that don't send one are unaffected.
